scope: Metadata-only audit. No data files retrieved. File names and sizes are taken from GEO filelist.txt manifests and FTP directory index pages.

items.title: Lamin A/C maintains genome topology and regulates transcriptional programs essential for virus-driven B cell activation. [Hi-C]

perturbation.type: knockout (sample characteristic 'lmnac genotype: KO'); stable, not acute siRNA

items.design: 2 conditions x 2 biological replicates (WT rep1/rep2; KO rep1/rep2)
items.resolutions_provided: none fixed; allValidPairs are fragment-level, so any bin size can be built. Data processing note says only 'at various resolutions'.

publication.title: Lamin A/C maintains genome topology and regulates transcriptional programs essential for virus-driven B cell activation.

required_work.liftover: none (hg19 matches GSE136252 predictor tracks and GSE126459 PC1)
required_work.compute: convert HiC-Pro allValidPairs to cooler (cooler cload pairs) or juicer .hic; ICE/KR balance at 500 kb
required_work.pc1_tool: HOMER runHiCpca.pl at 500 kb to match the GSE126459 HOMER PC1 convention, or cooltools eigs-cis with GC/gene-density sign orientation
required_work.notes: KO rep2 is ~2x shallower than the other libraries (1.0 GB vs 2.0-2.3 GB compressed pairs); check cis valid-pair counts before per-replicate PC1

items.why: Only unobserved human dataset with a direct LMNA loss-of-function vs isogenic-control Hi-C contrast, true biological replication (2v2), and the same genome build as the predictor. Main limitation is lineage: B-lymphoblastoid, not cardiac, and LADs/compartments are strongly lineage-specific.

items.title: Spatiotemporal remodeling of chromatin topology architecture and H3K27me3 redistribution underlies vascular pathology in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome [Hi-C]
items.cell_line: iPSC-derived vascular smooth muscle cells; lines BJ1C (male control), 0901C (female control), AG1B (female HGPS), 0031C (male HGPS)

perturbation.type: patient-derived HGPS iPSC-VSMC vs control iPSC-VSMC
perturbation.acute_or_chronic: chronic; two passages P7 and P14

items.design: 4 cell lines (2 control, 2 HGPS) x 2 passages (P7, P14). Technical/biological replicates were merged with hicSumMatrix before deposit, so each deposited file is one merged matrix.
items.resolutions_provided: 5 kb matrices; 100 kb TAD calls; loop calls

publication.title: Spatiotemporal remodeling of chromatin topology architecture and H3K27me3 redistribution underlies vascular pathology in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome

required_work.liftover: required - GRCh38 vs hg19 tile set (lift the 500 kb tile set hg19->hg38, or lift PC1 output back)
required_work.compute: hicMergeMatrixBins 5 kb -> 500 kb, hicCorrectMatrix (KR/ICE), hicPCA for PC1; or hicConvertFormat to cool and use cooltools
required_work.pc1_tool: HiCExplorer hicPCA, or cooltools eigs-cis after conversion; orient sign by GC/gene density
required_work.notes: No within-condition replicates survive in the deposit (replicates merged), so n = 2 control vs 2 HGPS lines per passage.

items.why: Independent human Hi-C with a lamin A/C pathology, but progerin is a gain-of-function/dominant-negative class, not LMNA loss of function, so it is a different perturbation class from the registered predictor. The paper itself reports a global loss of A/B compartment segregation at late passage (P14), which can produce a non-specific B-ward drift and confound a directional tile-level test; P7 is the cleaner contrast.

items.title: Spatiotemporal remodeling of chromatin topology architecture and H3K27me3 redistribution underlies vascular pathology in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome [CUT&Tag]
items.cell_line: iPSC-derived vascular smooth muscle cells (control and HGPS)
items.assay: CUT&Tag for CTCF, SMC1A, H3K27me3, H3K27ac, H3K36me3
items.processed_files_per_sample: not enumerated in this audit; series supplementary is GSE312029_RAW.tar only
items.why: No lamin target (no LMNB1 or lamin A/C antibody in the panel) and no Hi-C, so it cannot serve as either the outcome or the LMNB1 predictor. Useful only as chromatin-state context for GSE312031.

items.title: Correlated alterations in genome organization, histone methylation, and DNA-lamina interactions in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome (Hi-C)
items.cell_line: primary dermal fibroblasts: HGPS patient (p17, p19), patient's father (p18), age-matched control (p20)
items.design: 3 individuals; the HGPS line appears twice as two passages (p17, p19), so there are no true biological replicates within a genotype - the 2 HGPS samples are passages of one patient and the 2 controls are two different donors.
items.pipeline: Bowtie2 iterative mapping + Imakaev iterative correction
items.resolutions_provided: 200 kb bins (smoothed to 1 Mb / 200 kb step for figures)

required_work.liftover: required - hg18 -> hg19 (UCSC liftOver chain hg18ToHg19); 200 kb native bins do not nest cleanly into 500 kb tiles
required_work.compute: PC1 from the supplied 200 kb IntMatrix (eigendecomposition of the correlation matrix per chromosome), or rebuild from validPair files
required_work.pc1_tool: cooltools eigs-cis after conversion, or a direct per-chromosome correlation-matrix eigenvector on the IntMatrix
required_work.notes: Bin-size mismatch plus a two-step coordinate translation adds meaningful attenuation; low sequencing depth by modern standards.

items.why: Historically the reference HGPS compartment dataset, but hg18, 200 kb bins, no within-genotype biological replication, progerin gain-of-function class, and dermal fibroblast lineage. Adequate as a descriptive supporting look, not as the pre-registered replication cohort.

items.title: Correlated alterations in genome organization, histone methylation, and DNA-lamina interactions in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome (ChIP-seq)
items.cell_line: primary dermal fibroblasts (HGPS, Father, Age Control)
items.assay: ChIP-seq for H3K27me3 and lamin A/C (not lamin B1); 2 biological replicates
items.why: Lamin A/C, not LMNB1; fibroblast, not cardiomyocyte; hg18; deposited as raw aligned-read BED with no normalized signal track, so domains would have to be called from scratch. Wrong protein and wrong lineage for the registered predictor.

items.title: Pathogenic LMNA variation disrupts a tissue-specific lamina-chromatin signature, resulting in loss of cellular identity
items.cell_line: hiPSC-derived cardiac myocytes (d25, d45), hepatocytes (d23), adipocytes (d25); control, LMNA T10I, LMNA R541C

perturbation.class: pathogenic missense variants T10I and R541C

items.assay: ChIP-seq for lamin B1 (LB1) and H3K9me2 with matched inputs; RNA-seq
items.pipeline: bwa aln + Picard dedup; deeptools bamCoverage --normalizeUsing RPGC then bigWigCompare subtract input; EDD 1.1.18 for LAD/KDD calling; epic2 + DiffBind for differential peaks
items.per_sample_processed_files: NONE. Every GSM in this series has '!Sample_supplementary_file_1 = NONE'. All processed tracks are series-level and are generated from merged BAMs pooled across replicates within a condition.

cardiomyocyte_lamin_b1_peak_and_differen.note: ready-made LMNB1-gained set, T10I vs control CM at d25
ready-made LMNB1-gained set, T10I vs control CM at d45

required_work.compute: bin the input-subtracted RPGC bigWigs to 500 kb (bigWigAverageOverBed / pyBigWig) and take T10I-minus-control and R541C-minus-control deltas; or use the supplied d25/d45 LB gained-peak BEDs directly
required_work.notes: Caveat: no per-replicate tracks exist, so a predictor derived here has n = 1 track per condition and no replicate-level variance. Any replication must treat the predictor as a fixed region set, not a re-estimated per-sample statistic.

items.why: Best available independent LMNB1 predictor in human cardiomyocytes: same lineage as the registered predictor, same build (hg19), chronic LMNA mutation rather than acute siRNA, and the deposit already ships LMNB1 gained/lost region sets for CM at two differentiation times. Cannot supply per-sample variance.

items.title: Nuclear peripheral chromatin-lamin B1 interaction is required for global integrity of chromatin architecture and dynamics in human cells
items.cell_line: MDA-MB-231 breast cancer, wild-type and LMNB1 knockout
items.design: 2 replicates per Hi-C condition; 3 replicates per lamin A ChIP-seq; 3 replicates per RNA-seq
items.assay: Hi-C, lamin A ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq
items.resolutions_provided: 500 kb whole-genome and 40 kb per-chromosome, raw and ICED

required_work.compute: PC1 from the supplied 500 kb ICED matrices - native 500 kb bins, so no rebinning
required_work.pc1_tool: cooltools eigs-cis or HOMER after HiC-Pro-to-cooler conversion
required_work.notes: Aneuploid cancer line; copy-number will distort eigenvectors and must be handled.

items.why: Wrong gene for the outcome (LMNB1 KO, not LMNA), and a highly aneuploid cancer line. Its value is as a specificity check: if LMNB1-gained tiles move B under LMNB1 loss as well, the predictor is not LMNA-specific. 500 kb ICED matrices at 2v2 make it cheap to run.

items.title: Genome models integrating chromatin contacts and nuclear lamin-genome interactions reveal implications of laminopathy-causing lamin mutations on genome architecture
items.cell_line: primary human skin fibroblasts (3 control, 4 FPLD2 patients all LMNA p.R482W) and HeLa overexpressing Flag-LMNA wt / R388P / L647R
items.assay: lamin A/C ChIP-seq and RNA-seq; no new Hi-C (genome models built from public Hi-C)
items.why: No Hi-C of its own, so it cannot replicate the compartment outcome. Lamin A/C (not LMNB1) in fibroblasts, so it is also a poor fit for the LMNB1 predictor. Listed for completeness.

items.title: Gene regulatory loops at lamina-associated domains
items.cell_line: primary human adipose stem cells (ASC), day 0/1/3 of adipogenesis
items.assay: lamin A/C ChIP-seq (2 replicates per day), histone ChIP-seq, public enhancer capture Hi-C
items.why: Has exactly the per-replicate normalized lamin signal tracks that GSE136252 lacks, but the protein is lamin A/C, the lineage is adipose, and there is no LMNA perturbation. Not a predictor for a cardiomyocyte LMNB1 hypothesis.

items.title: Reprogramming of three-dimensional chromatin architecture drives human dilated cardiomyopathy
items.cell_line: human non-failing and failing (DCM) heart tissue; hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes
items.assay: in situ Hi-C, H3K27ac HiChIP, H3K27ac and HAND1 ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, RNA-seq
items.why: The only large human cardiac Hi-C resource found, but the contrast is dilated cardiomyopathy in general, with no stated LMNA genotype stratification in the design, so it does not provide an LMNA loss-of-function contrast. Possible future use as a cardiac compartment background/reference, not as the replication outcome.

items.title: Gene expression and chromatin organization changes in lamin A/C haploinsufficient human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes [Hi-C]
items.cell_line: hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes, LMNA R225X heterozygous mutant and two CRISPR-corrected isogenic control lines
items.design: 3 lines (mutant, corrected.1, corrected.2) x 2 biological replicates from independent differentiations
items.processed_files_per_sample: per GSM: 500000_iced.matrix.gz (~81-100 MB), 500KB_Active.PC1.bedGraph.gz (~74 KB), allValidPairs.pairs.txt.gz (~1.0-1.2 GB)
items.why: This is the cohort used in the registered test. Listed only to document that it is the sole human dataset found that ships per-sample 500 kb PC1 bedGraphs already computed, which is why it was the discovery cohort and why it cannot also serve as the replication.

items.title: Gene expression and chromatin organization changes in lamin A/C haploinsufficient hiPSC-CM (companion subseries)
items.assay: expression profiling and other (non-Hi-C) assays from the same study as GSE126459
items.why: Same study and same cell lines as the discovery cohort, therefore not independent.

items.title: Nuclear lamina binds the EBV genome during latency and regulates viral gene expression [Hi-C]
items.note: Same laboratory (Tempera) and EBV/LCL system as GSE314556; the perturbation is lamin-EBV genome binding rather than an LMNA loss-of-function host-genome contrast.
items.why: Not established to contain an LMNA-loss vs control human-genome Hi-C contrast; also shares a laboratory and cell system with the recommended cohort, which would weaken independence. Flagged for a follow-up look only if GSE314556 turns out to reuse these libraries.

items.title: Mutation-Agnostic Base Editing of the Progerin Farnesylation Site Rescues Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome
items.assay: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
items.why: Expression only, 3 samples, no chromosome conformation data. Matched the search on the word compartment.

items.title: An RNA polymerase III tissue and tumor atlas uncovers context-specific activities linked to 3D epigenome regulation
items.why: Pol III occupancy atlas; no LMNA perturbation. Incidental keyword match.

items.title: Transcriptional profiling of Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria syndrome fibroblasts reveals deficits in metabolism
items.why: Transcriptional profiling only, no conformation data.

items.title: APEX-seq spatial RNA profiling; Ki67 chromatin organization; 3D genomics across the tree of life; KAT7 senescence CRISPR screen; CpG island gene partitioning
items.organism: Homo sapiens (and other species for GSE163641)
items.why: Incidental keyword matches on compartment or LMNB1 with no LMNA loss-of-function contrast. Recorded so the search is auditable.
